## Common WHERE Filters

```sql
-- 分区过滤 (必须)
grass_date = date'2024-06-01'
grass_date between date'2024-12-01' and date'2024-12-07'
grass_region in ('ID', 'MY', 'PH', 'SG', 'TH', 'TW', 'VN', 'BR')
grass_region in ('${region}')  -- 变量模板
h between ${start_hour} and ${end_hour}  -- 小时过滤

-- AB 实验分组过滤
get_json_object(ext_info, '$.bucket_id') in ('196475','196476','196477','197054')

-- 广告级过滤 (需先 EXPLODE ads)
ads_info.placement in (2003)           -- Shop Ads Search
ads_info.placement in (3, 2003)        -- All Shop Ads Search
ads_info.placement in (2003, 2030)     -- Search + Discovery
ads_info.rank = 1                      -- Top-1 广告
ads_info.reason in (1)                 -- PICKED only
```

## Common JOIN Patterns

```sql
-- 1. LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE ads 数组展开 (最常用)
FROM mp_paidads.ods_log_trace_shop_ads_hi__reg_s0_live a
LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(ads) b AS ad

-- 2. EXPLODE + 多层过滤
SELECT region, bucket_id, ads_info.shop_id, ads_info.placement,
       ads_info.bid_price, ads_info.deduction_price, ads_info.ext_info
FROM (
    SELECT region, EXPLODE(ads) AS ads_info,
           get_json_object(ext_info, '$.bucket_id') AS bucket_id
    FROM mp_paidads.ods_log_trace_shop_ads_hi__reg_s0_live
    WHERE grass_date = date'2024-06-04'
) WHERE ads_info.rank = 1

-- 3. 展开 ads + rcmd_items 双重展开
FROM ads_trace_log a
LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(rcmd_items) ri AS b
WHERE reason IN ('PICKED') AND placement IN (3, 2003)

-- 4. 与 performance 表 JOIN (trace log 与效果数据关联)
FROM impression_rcmd_i2i_label a
LEFT JOIN performance_table b
  ON a.grass_region = b.grass_region
  AND a.request_id = b.request_id

-- 5. 与店铺分组表 JOIN (冷启动分析)
FROM trace_log a
JOIN shop_ads_budget_group_table y
  ON a.region = y.grass_region AND a.shop_id = y.shop_id
```

```sql

SELECT grass_date, COUNT(DISTINCT request_id)
FROM mp_paidads.ods_log_trace_shop_ads_hi__reg_s0_live
WHERE grass_date BETWEEN date'2024-11-25' AND date'2024-12-02'
  AND grass_region IN ('ID')

       COUNT(DISTINCT request_id, ads_id)
FROM ads_trace_log_has_picked
GROUP BY reason, has_picked

-- 出价分布分析
SELECT bucket_id, region,
       AVG(deduction_price), AVG(init_bid_price),
       APPROX_PERCENTILE(deduction_price, 0.3) AS p30,
       APPROX_PERCENTILE(deduction_price, 0.5) AS p50,
       APPROX_PERCENTILE(deduction_price, 0.7) AS p70,
       APPROX_PERCENTILE(deduction_price, 0.9) AS p90
FROM (...) GROUP BY bucket_id, region

-- I2I 覆盖统计
SELECT grass_region, ab_sign,
       SUM(has_i2i) AS i2i_request_cnt,
       SUM(has_rcmd_or_i2i) AS rcdm_or_i2i_request_cnt
FROM impression_rcmd_i2i_label
GROUP BY grass_region, ab_sign

-- 冷启动店铺统计
SELECT a.group_index, SUM(ads_click), SUM(broad_order),
       SUM(ads_rev), SUM(broad_gmv)
FROM trace_shop_log a
JOIN performance_table b ON ...
WHERE pid_status = 2
GROUP BY a.group_index
```

### Snippet 2: EXPLODE ads 并分析出价 (含 JSON 解析)
```sql
SELECT bucket_id, region,
       AVG(deduction_price) AS deduction_price,
       APPROX_PERCENTILE(deduction_price, 0.1) AS price_p10,
       APPROX_PERCENTILE(deduction_price, 0.5) AS price_p50
FROM (
    SELECT region, bucket_id, shop_id, bid_price, deduction_price,
           get_json_object(ext_info, '$.init_bid_price') AS init_bid_price,
           get_json_object(ext_info, '$.target_roi') AS target_roi,
           get_json_object(ext_info, '$.aov') AS aov,
           get_json_object(ext_info, '$.pcr') AS pcr,
           get_json_object(ext_info, '$.pctr') AS pctr,
           get_json_object(ext_info, '$.bidding_info') AS bidding_info
    FROM (
        SELECT region, bucket_id, ads_info.shop_id, ads_info.placement,
               ads_info.bid_price, ads_info.deduction_price, ads_info.ext_info
        FROM (
            SELECT region, EXPLODE(ads) AS ads_info,
                   get_json_object(ext_info, '$.bucket_id') AS bucket_id
            FROM mp_paidads.ods_log_trace_shop_ads_hi__reg_s0_live
            WHERE grass_date = date'2024-06-04'
              AND get_json_object(ext_info, '$.bucket_id') IN ('196477','197054')
        ) WHERE ads_info.rank = 1
    ) WHERE placement IN (2003)
) GROUP BY bucket_id, region
```

### Snippet 3: LATERAL VIEW + CACHE 模式 (I2I 分析)
```sql
CREATE OR REPLACE TEMPORARY VIEW ads_trace_log AS
SELECT a.grass_region, a.request_id, a.user_id,
       CASE
           WHEN b.ad.reason IN (1) THEN 'PICKED'
           WHEN b.ad.reason IN (3) THEN 'UNPICKED_RANK_LOW_PCTR_SCORE'
           WHEN b.ad.reason IN (7) THEN 'UNPICKED_TRUNCATED'
           WHEN b.ad.reason IN (13) THEN 'UNPICKED_FILTER_LOW_RELEVANCE'
           WHEN b.ad.reason IN (14) THEN 'UNPICKED_FILTER_INACTIVE_ADS'
           WHEN b.ad.reason IN (16) THEN 'UNPICKED_RANK_LOW_ECPM_SCORE'
           WHEN b.ad.reason IN (18) THEN 'UNPICKED_RANK_LOW_BID_PRICE'
       END AS reason,
       b.ad.placement, b.ad.ads_id, b.ad.shop_id,
       b.ad.top_item_ids, b.ad.top_vouchers, b.ad.rcmd_items
FROM mp_paidads.ods_log_trace_shop_ads_hi__reg_s0_live a
LATERAL VIEW EXPLODE(ads) b AS ad
WHERE grass_region IN ('${region}')
  AND grass_date IN (date'${run_date}')
  AND h BETWEEN ${start_hour} AND ${end_hour}
;
CACHE LAZY TABLE ads_trace_log;
```

### Snippet 4: 冷启动分析 (pid_status=2)
```sql
SELECT a.group_index,
       SUM(ads_click) AS ads_click, SUM(broad_order) AS broad_order,
       SUM(ads_rev) AS ads_rev, SUM(broad_gmv) AS broad_gmv
FROM (
    SELECT x.grass_date, x.region, x.shop_id, y.group_index
    FROM (
        SELECT grass_date, region, ads_info.shop_id
        FROM (
            SELECT grass_date, region, EXPLODE(ads) AS ads_info
            FROM mp_paidads.ods_log_trace_shop_ads_hi__reg_s0_live
            WHERE grass_date BETWEEN date'2024-12-01' AND date'2024-12-07'
        ) WHERE CAST(get_json_object(ads_info.ext_info, '$.pid_status') AS int) = 2
        GROUP BY grass_date, region, shop_id
    ) x
    JOIN shop_ads_budget_group_table y
      ON x.region = y.grass_region AND x.shop_id = y.shop_id
) a
JOIN dwd_advertise_performance_di b
  ON a.region = b.grass_region AND a.shop_id = b.shop_id AND a.grass_date = b.grass_date
GROUP BY a.group_index
```

## Derived Metrics (派生指标)

以下是从 trace log 的 `ads` 数组和 `ext_info` JSON 中派生的常用字段 (需在 2 个以上文件中出现):

| Derived Field | Expression | Usage |
|---------------|------------|-------|
| bucket_id | `get_json_object(ext_info, '$.bucket_id')` | AB 实验分组 |
| init_bid_price | `get_json_object(ext_info, '$.init_bid_price')` | 初始出价分析 |
| target_roi | `get_json_object(ext_info, '$.target_roi')` | Target ROI 分析 |
| aov | `get_json_object(ext_info, '$.aov')` | 客单价 |
| pcr (pCVR) | `get_json_object(ext_info, '$.pcr')` | 预估转化率 |
| pctr (pCTR) | `get_json_object(ext_info, '$.pctr')` | 预估点击率 |
| pid_status | `get_json_object(ads_info.ext_info, '$.pid_status')` | PID 状态 (2=冷启动) |
| bidding_info | `get_json_object(ext_info, '$.bidding_info')` | 出价详情 (MinBidCap, MaxBidCap, BidPriceFromVespa, BidPriceCalculated, BidPriceAfterCapping) |
| reason_label | `CASE WHEN reason IN (1) THEN 'PICKED' WHEN reason IN (3) THEN 'UNPICKED_RANK_LOW_PCTR_SCORE' ... END` | reason 枚举转可读标签 |
| has_picked | `request_id IS NOT NULL` (JOIN picked 子查询) | 该请求是否有 picked 广告 |
| has_i2i | `MAX(CAST((item_type = 3) AS bigint))` | rcmd_items 中是否有 I2I 推荐 (item_type=3) |
